description: Create a compelling DATA STORY VIDEO as one self-contained HTML file: big counters, bar charts that grow and annotate themselves, line charts that draw with a moving marker, donuts, comparisons and a closing line, all driven by real data, with a synthesized score that marks every number. Verified frame by frame and exportable to MP4. Use for year-in-review and "wrapped" videos, results and impact reports, investor and board updates, KPI recaps, survey findings, case-study numbers and any "show these metrics as a video" request, for any company, team or project, in any style. Accepts creative dials --creativity, --typography, --animation and --motion (low, medium or high; medium by default).
